com.viaoa.uicontroller

Class OAUITableController

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.viaoa.uicontroller.OAUITableController

  • public abstract class OAUITableController
extends Object
    Used by UI Components that use a Hub to present a listing to populate an HTML Table. For multi-select, it uses a hubSelect.
